reference: Actual original FLASH_ATTN_EXT graph with use_ref=false; forced-use_ref is separately stored diagnostic, never the expected default output.
notes: Q stays F32 for F16/F32 K CPU dot types. Default query tiling and split KV are separately source-selected numerical paths, not mere cache conversions.
Frozen MSVC build has no __SSE2__ macro; GNU has __SSE2__. Both lack GGML_SIMD and use scalar simd-gemm fallback; GNU tiled softmax uses its SSE2 exponential prefix.
Workers 1/2/4 are explicit plan.n_threads. Default expected and forced-use_ref outputs share exact raw input bytes.

Masks include holes, entire masked KV tiles, fully masked query rows, padded query rows and mask-head/batch broadcasting. Finite inputs and mask -Inf only; exceptional floating-environment behavior is not claimed here.
Nonzero K/V head view offsets, permuted cache-like layouts and GQA preserve source byte strides.
Default rounding and gradual underflow are assumed as in prior verified profiles; no altered FP environment is set.
